note: What a server sends to create a champion played by a bot. A client first deletes any object it holds under the same id. The header carries zero.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The id the bot's champion takes.

fields.name: node
fields.note: The network node it belongs to.

fields.name: x
fields.note: Where it appears, in world units.

fields.name: y
fields.note: Its height, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Where it appears, in world units.

fields.name: rank
fields.note: The bot's rank.

fields.name: sides
fields.note: Its side.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which skin.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name shown for it. The text ends at its first zero byte, which falls within the field.

fields.name: character
fields.note: The champion's character name, which is also its unique name.
